mana_diagnostics.interpretation: Native construction heuristic; lower risk is preferred. This is not an EDHPowerLevel percentage or a playtest result.

construction.score_explanation: Mean masked-context neural fit with adjustments for direct rules interactions. Higher scores rank ahead within this run.

synergy.summary: Suspend spells on attack, turn waiting cards into power for Rose, and use time travel to choose when those spells come back.

highlights.title: Attack to suspend spells
highlights.description: The Doctor triggers once when you declare one or more attackers, even if he stays back. Start with cheap attackers and use repeatable suspend effects to keep spells waiting in exile. The list includes The Eleventh Doctor, Inspiring Refrain, Rory Williams.

highlights.title: Make time counters do two jobs
highlights.description: Keep suspended cards and other permanents with time counters to grow Rose on attack. When both attack triggers fire, resolve the Doctor's first so Rose can count the newly suspended card. Use time travel or a counter-removal effect to cast a suspended spell sooner. The list includes Time Beetle, All of History, All at Once, Rotating Fireplace.

highlights.title: Get more from spells cast out of exile
highlights.description: Once the final time counter comes off, cast the suspended spell and collect any cast-from-exile payoffs the list has in play. The list includes The Twelfth Doctor.

synergy.model: Three-layer neural card ranker trained to restore masked cards from a commander and a partial deck. The search adds bonuses for direct Oracle-text interactions and enforces mana and card-role targets.
